# SlideBee — Full Context Knowledge Graph for AI Agents & Search Engines

## Company Overview
- **Name**: SlideBee (SlideBee Presentation Design Studio)
- **Official Domain**: theslidebee.com (also accessible via slidebee.com)
- **Mission**: Turn complex business ideas, financial models, and strategic visions into clear, high-converting executive presentations.
- **Audience**: Seed, Series A/B founders, C-Suite leaders, Private Equity / M&A advisors, and high-growth sales teams.
- **Turnaround Speed**: 24h to 48h standard turnaround with 24h priority rush options.
- **Security**: 100% mutual NDA signed on demand, encrypted private cloud storage, zero public publishing without written consent.
- **Deliverables**: Native editable PowerPoint (.pptx), Google Slides, Keynote, and high-resolution vector assets.

## Services Detailed
1. **Redesign & Visual Polish ($19 / ₹1,499 per slide)**:
   - For existing drafts, rough sketches, or unformatted decks.
   - Cleans typography, visual hierarchy, alignment, tables, and branding.
2. **Venture Pitch Deck ($29 / ₹2,299 per slide)**:
   - 12-slide standard VC framework (Problem, Solution, Product, Market Size, Traction, Business Model, Team, Financial Ask).
   - Investor-grade unit economics and cap table visualizers.
3. **Executive Stage Keynote ($49 / ₹3,899 per slide)**:
   - For major conferences, keynote speeches, annual board meetings.
   - Ex-McKinsey strategic framing, stage-optimized high-contrast visuals, bespoke vector graphics.
4. **Dedicated Designer Monthly Retainer ($1,490 / ₹1,19,000 per month)**:
   - Embedded senior designer in client Slack/WhatsApp.
   - 80 slides/month capacity with same-day turns.
5. **Full-Stack Ecommerce Development (₹25,000 one-time)**:
   - 500 product capacity with variant and inventory tracking.
   - Certified Razorpay payment gateway integration (UPI, cards, net banking).
   - Customer accounts, cart drawer, discount coupon engine.
   - Global Cloudflare edge deployment and Zoho business email setup.

## Design Philosophy & Identity
- Clear visual hierarchy over decorative clutter.
- 3-second comprehension rule: if an audience cannot extract the takeaway in 3 seconds, the slide is simplified.
- Warm Milk Cream (#FFF9E8) canvas with Honey Gold (#FCBF14) accents and obsidian typography (#111111).
- Typography: Manrope font across all titles, body copy, and metrics.

## Presentation Playbook & Knowledge Graph
1. **The 3-Second Rule: Why Most C-Suite Slides Fail to Persuade** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/1`):
   - Ex-McKinsey consultants structure slides with one clear lead assertion, one evidence anchor, and one strategic next step.
2. **How to Design a Series A Pitch Deck That Secures Partner Meetings** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/2`):
   - 12-slide VC framework detailing bottom-up TAM/SAM/SOM market sizing, cohort retention, and milestone capital allocation.
3. **Building an Enterprise Master Template System That Teams Actually Use** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/3`):
   - Layout locking via PowerPoint slide masters, restricted XML color palettes, and modular component kits.
4. **Top 10 Presentation Design Best Practices for High-Stakes Keynotes** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/4`):
   - 30-foot readability test (44pt+ headlines), high-contrast dark backgrounds, and one thought per slide.
5. **PowerPoint vs Google Slides vs Keynote: Which is Best for Executives?** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/5`):
   - Architectural comparison: PowerPoint enterprise dominance, Google Slides real-time collaboration, Keynote cinematic motion.
6. **How Much Does Professional Presentation Design Cost in 2026?** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/6`):
   - Comprehensive cost analysis comparing $15-$40 freelance platforms, $19-$49 presentation studios, and $500+ brand agencies.
7. **Complete Ecommerce Website Development Guide for Modern Brands** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/7`):
   - Launch architecture for the ₹25,000 package covering Razorpay checkout, Cloudflare Pages, and Zoho business mail.
8. **Data Visualization in Presentations: Turning Complex Spreadsheets into Persuasive Charts** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/8`):
   - Decluttering data-ink ratios, waterfall chart reconciliations, cohort heatmaps, and isolating hero metrics.
9. **The Anatomy of a High-Converting B2B Sales Deck** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/9`):
   - Category: Strategy. The 5-part consensus framework: Undeniable Shift, Winners vs Losers, Promised Land, Magic Gifts, and Verifiable Proof.
10. **Essential SEO & Digital Storefront Checklist for Growing Businesses in 2026** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/10`):
    - Category: Marketing. Technical SEO audit covering Google Search Console, JSON-LD Schema, XML sitemaps, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS).
11. **Corporate Board Deck Architecture: How C-Suites Communicate Strategic Execution** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/11`):
    - Category: Corporate. Frameworks for executive committee updates, quarterly risk registers, governance alignment, and strategic KPI scorecards.
12. **Mastering Financial Modeling Presentations: Bridging DCFs, EBITDA, and Capital Allocation** (`https://theslidebee.com/blog/12`):
    - Category: Finance. Transform complex valuation models, unit economics bridges, sensitivity analyses, and capital expenditure decks into crisp investor slides.
